Class SocketProxyPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.proxies.PhasedProxyPlayer
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.proxies.SocketProxyPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, Heartbeatable, VirtualClient, VirtualGameClient, VirtualHallClient, VirtualRoomClient, VirtualGameServer, VirtualHallServer, VirtualRoomServer, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
public class SocketProxyPlayer extends PhasedProxyPlayer
The SocketProxyPlayer class is the Socket-specific implementation of the PhasedProxyPlayer. It manages the bidirectional communication between the server and a client connected via TCP Sockets. Unlike the RMI implementation which relies on remote method invocations, this class runs a continuous listening loop to receive and deserialize Datapacket objects, routing them based on their type. It strictly synchronizes outgoing transmissions to prevent stream corruption.

  • Constructor Details

    • SocketProxyPlayer

      public SocketProxyPlayer(ServerMultiplexer server, String nickname, ApplicationPhase startingPhase, VirtualServerAdapter serverSide, ObjectInputStream input, ObjectOutputStream output)
      Constructs a new SocketProxyPlayer. Since this is a Socket connection, the RMI client stub is explicitly set to null.
      Parameters:
      server - the main server multiplexer.
      nickname - the unique nickname of the player.
      startingPhase - the initial application phase (usually HALL).
      serverSide - the adapter linking the proxy to the current server logic.
      input - the input stream to read incoming packets.
      output - the output stream to send outgoing packets.

    • runVirtualClient

      public void runVirtualClient() throws SocketException
      Starts the main listening loop for this socket client. It continuously reads incoming Datapacket objects, resets the heartbeat timeout, validates the application phase, and routes the packet to the appropriate server method based on its datapacketType.
      Overrides:
      runVirtualClient in class PhasedProxyPlayer
      Throws:
      SocketException - if the connection drops unexpectedly.
